name: Afterglow by soum91
subtitle: Tuya lights, local and fast
description: Controls Tuya/Smart Life lights straight over Wi-Fi (cloud as fallback) with scenes, widgets, Control Center toggles, Siri, and an ESP32 bridge that puts them in Apple Home and turns them off when the TV goes off.
